title: stint storage config file (config.json)
description: The §13 config file both surfaces read BEFORE anything opens ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/stint/config.json on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/stint/config.json on macOS, TT_CONFIG overriding). Exactly two OPTIONAL absolute-path keys — dbPath and backupDir; an absent key means the next ladder rung, and reset means deleting the key. Anything outside this shape — an unknown key, a relative path, a non-string value — is an UNTRUSTED file that refuses the launch loudly (§20 R10); additionalProperties: false is that contract.
